correctness.rationale: Every forbidden triple was identified using wheel diameter two; hub-free faces equal Ind_2(C_n), hub-containing faces cone the embedded rim cycle. The cofiber argument uses actual homotopy (not homology) and the published all-n homotopy theorem for the cycle. For n>=6 the rim complex is simply connected so the attaching circle is null, giving a wedge S2. For n=4 the attaching cycle is a primitive free generator in K4 as a graph; for n=5 complete face and vertex-link incidence, Euler characteristic 1 prove an RP2 triangulation; for n=3 the wheel is a clique. An independent finite shortest-path face oracle and GF(2) chain reduction corroborates all n from 3 through 12. Risk: correct interpretation of standard homotopy cofiber and cycle theorem, which is explicit.
